# Victoria Ho

**Headline:** Biopharma Medical Capabilities and Excellence
**Current role:** Global Head Of Field Medical (MSLs)
**Location:** Old Burghclere, England, United Kingdom
**Experience:** 26 years 11 months
**LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/vic-ho-medical-excellence · 899 followers
**Description:** Medical Excellence, Capabilities, Strategy and Communications Executive with 20 years Medical Affairs experience in a range of Global, Regional and Country Field Medical Liaison leadership roles including 10 years first line management. In-depth, scientific, customer facing record in neuroscience, virology (Hep B and C and HIV), anticoagulation and diabetes. Strategic and energetic advocate of the power of Medical Affairs to accelerate patient centric company efforts with a solid understanding of the value of scientific exchange at all stages of a product’s lifecycle. Committed to upholding the highest standards of scientific rigour and proactively looking for opportunities to drive performance. Enjoys challenging groups and individuals to work beyond their current skillset and collaborate beyond geographical and functional borders. All views expressed on LinkedIn are my own and do not represent the views of the companies I have or am working with.
